description: Source code for WiFi Off Channel Scan (OCS) feature, including configuration, event handling, and data processing functions for 5G radios.

methods.name: get_wifi_ocs
methods.description: Retrieves the OCS configuration for a given radio index.

methods.name: print_ocs_state
methods.description: Prints the current state of the off-channel scan feature.

methods.name: config_ocs_neighbour_scan
methods.description: Configures neighbor scan parameters for a given radio.

methods.name: config_ocs_chan_util
methods.description: Configures channel utilization data collection.

methods.name: push_ocs_config_event_to_monitor_queue
methods.description: Pushes configuration events to the monitor queue to start or stop scans.

methods.name: SetOffChanTscan
methods.description: Sets the Tscan parameter for off-channel scanning.

methods.name: SetOffChanNscan
methods.description: Sets the Nscan parameter for off-channel scanning.

methods.name: SetOffChanTidle
methods.description: Sets the Tidle parameter for off-channel scanning.

methods.name: SetOffChanParams
methods.description: Wrapper to set all off-channel scan parameters.

methods.name: off_chan_print_neighbour_data
methods.description: Prints neighbor data for 5G off-channel scan results.

methods.name: off_chan_print_chan_stats_data
methods.description: Prints channel utilization statistics.

methods.name: config_ocs
methods.description: Configures off-channel scan for all radios.

methods.name: handle_ocs_command_event
methods.description: Handles command events related to OCS.

methods.name: handle_monitor_ocs_event
methods.description: Handles monitor events for OCS, including neighbor and channel stats.

methods.name: validate_ocs
methods.description: Validates and applies OCS configuration parameters.

methods.name: handle_ocs_webconfig_event
methods.description: Handles web configuration events for OCS.

methods.name: ocs_event
methods.description: Main event handler for OCS-related events.

methods.name: ocs_init
methods.description: Initializes the OCS module.

methods.name: ocs_deinit

methods.name: off_chan_scan_init
